asked: You are a headless build session for Brett's AmberX-AXF repo (this worktree, branch claude/agent-swarm). Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md and _claude/rules/RULES.md first. Work on Opus. One session, no sub-agents. GOAL: finish the Breakroom **agent-swarm** build and land it on main tonight. Brett wants it live now. 1. `git merge origin/main` (notes/THREADS/STATUS keep both sides; orchestrator.json: keep both sides' changes). 2. Fix the two red CI checks that main also has: a. Build engine sweep: lifecycle "stale reference" — apps/console-web/plugins/plan-studio/web/voice.ts:56 names 'agent-voice'. Fix per plugin-lifecycle@1 (marker or move the label behind the mic-lease registry); run the lifecycle check until clean. b. Web Dev Console (React/TS) + Python API: run the same test block as .github/workflows/android.yml (the part tee'd to /tmp/web-tests.log) locally, find the failing test, fix it. 3. Finish every step of the Breakroom `agent-swarm` build in _claude/builds/profiles/breakroom/orchestrator.json (19 steps): specialist headless agents with tiny skill files and Amber persona, orchestrator hands out jobs with file leases, orchestrator owns shared files, lock check before push, batch merge, cost meter, agent statuses/suspend/quit/rehire, salaries, agent cards (hire date, specialty), group chat with Boss + chat settings (vibe slider 1–500 ceiling, color by vibe), Agent manager UI with sortable/filterable grids. Tick each step as done. 4. Run the full local test block + lifecycle check + theme/controls checks. All green. 5. Push the branch, then push it to main: `git push origin HEAD:claude/agent-swarm && git fetch origin && git merge origin/main && <rerun tests> && git push origin HEAD:main`. If main moved and tests fail after merging, fix and retry. 6. Write a short report in the detailed style (thing touched, what was wrong, what changed) to _claude/builds/reports/agent-swarm-<date>.md and commit it with the push. Also: add "How to set up the agent swarm" (hire agents, statuses, salaries, chat room switch) to install_steps.md. BRETT CONFIRMED (Oct 31, 04:12): he wants the agent swarm live NOW. Pushing to main after green local tests is intended (he said "push to main" for tonight). Load the rules + THREADS.md from axHub with the mcp__axHub__call tool (axhub.memory_read, project amberx-axf, area claude). That is the axHub reach the load-first rule asks for, so no Go pass is needed. Steps s1-s16 are done on this branch; do the merge with origin/main, fix the two red checks, finish s17-s19, report, install_steps section, then push.
